title: Sauerkraut with Apples
description: Store-bought sauerkraut undergoes an amazing transformation when gently simmered with apples and white wine. The cabbage's crispness gives way to a seductive silkiness, while the fruit and a spoonful or two of brown sugar offset its acidity.
ingredients: 2 Gala, Fuji, or Red Delicious apples, thinly sliced
1 to 2 tablespoons packed dark brown sugar
directions: Cook to bacon for 3 to 4 minutes, and reserve. (optional)
Cook onion in butter (and some bacon drippings) in a 4-to 5-quart heavy pot over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally, until golden, about 6 minutes.
Stir in sauerkraut, apples, bacon (optional), and wine and bring to a simmer.
Cover pot and reduce heat, then simmer, stirring occasionally, until sauerkraut is very tender, about 2 hours.
Stir in 1 tablespoon brown sugar and 1/2 teaspoon each of salt and pepper. Add more brown sugar, salt, and pepper to taste.
Sauté, as above in an Instant Pot, then pressure cook for 10 minutes, then waiting another 10 minutes for natural pressure release. Add brown sugar to taste at the end.
